textContent:
1. Type of animation will depend on the perspective of the character we are watching the story with!
2. Each and every person have their own perspective and way of looking the world and hence a different type of animation!
3. Red for one person can be a different color with the eyes of another!!!!
title: Animation rule of thumb
textContentHtml:
1. Type of animation will depend on the perspective of the character we are watching the story with!

2. Each and every person have their own perspective and way of looking the world and hence a different type of animation!

3. Red for one person can be a different color with the eyes of another!!!!
